careers.descriptionTemplate: Join Global Health in {country}. We work with registered doctors, clinical support and technology teams across Europe and Brazil. See how to apply.
careers.introTemplate: Global Health connects patients in {country} with registered doctors online. Behind every consultation is a team of clinicians, clinical-operations staff and engineers working across our markets — and we are always glad to hear from people who want to join them.
careers.heroImageAlt: Doctors and care team working at Global Health
careers.trustRemoteSubtitle: Work from anywhere in our markets
careers.whyHeading: Work that reaches patients in six countries
careers.whyBodyTemplate: We keep the team small and the standards high. Whether you consult with patients, support them around a booking, or build the platform itself, your work goes live for patients in {country} and across every market we operate in.
careers.pillarDoctorsBody: Consult online with the national medical register behind you. You set your availability; we handle bookings, payments and the technology around the consultation.
careers.pillarOpsBody: Help patients before and after their consultation — bookings, documents, follow-ups — in the languages our markets speak.
careers.pillarTechBody: Build the platform that delivers regulated healthcare online: booking, records, prescriptions and everything between, across six countries.
careers.rolesBody: We do not list vacancies on this page. If you are a registered doctor, a clinical-support professional or an engineer and want to work with us, send your CV and a few lines about yourself — we read every application and reply to those we can take further.
careers.doctorNoteTemplate: Doctors: registration with {regulator} (or an equivalent register in one of our markets) is required before you can consult with patients in {country}.

press.descriptionTemplate: Press information about Global Health in {country}: who operates the service, how it is regulated, the markets we serve and how to reach our press contact.
press.introTemplate: Information for journalists writing about Global Health in {country} — who we are, who operates the service, and how to verify what we do.
press.heroImageAlt: Global Health press and media information
press.trustMarketsSubtitle: Ireland · Spain · Portugal · Czechia · Romania · Brazil
press.boilerplateBody1: Global Health is an online healthcare service connecting patients with registered doctors for video consultations, medical certificates, prescriptions and laboratory tests. The service operates in Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Czechia, Romania and Brazil, with consultations delivered in the local language and in English.
press.boilerplateBody2Template: In {country}, consultations are delivered by doctors registered with {regulator}. {entity}
press.boilerplateReuse: You are welcome to reuse this description verbatim in your reporting.
press.factMarketsValue: Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Czechia, Romania, Brazil
press.contactBody: For interviews, comments, data or fact-checking, email us and mention your outlet and deadline — we prioritise journalists on deadline.
